```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
nb_id <- "20260611"
here::i_am(paste0("notebooks/", nb_id, ".qmd"))

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(qs2)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, warning = F, message = T)

out_dir <- file.path(here("data", "processed"), nb_id)
res_dir <- file.path(here("results"), nb_id)

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir)
if (!dir.exists(res_dir)) dir.create(res_dir)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 9))
```

## Data overview

The cleaned stimuli (with repetition number) and the session-specific block orders can be read from `data/processed/20260521` and the averaged MUAs saved with `qs2` can be read from `data/processed/20260604`. 

```{r}
stimuli <- read.csv(
  file.path(here("data", "processed", "20260521"), "stimuli.csv"))
mua_avgs <- qs_read(
  file.path(here("data", "processed", "20260604"), "mua_avgs.qs2"))
```
